text:
Ashley: Heads up — the auditor asked for a minimally scoped evidence bundle showing RBAC changes + KMS key usage for the January incident. They want chain-of-custody, log snapshots, and export steps by end of week. Can we commit?

Omar: I can assemble the RBAC change diff and role binding snapshots. Which clusters/services are in scope?

Auditor_McKay: Scope: production k8s clusters (us-east-1, eu-west-1), S3 buckets with artifacts, and KMS master keys used to encrypt repo secrets. Need start/end timestamps and a short narrative for each artifact.

Sara: For clarity — do you want just the API audit logs, or also admin console screenshots and SCIM/Okta change events?

Auditor_McKay: API audit logs + admin console export. SCIM events are optional but helpful for cross-correlation.

Omar: Plan: 1) Export k8s audit logs for the window (2026-01-12T00:00:00Z -> 2026-01-13T12:00:00Z) 2) RBAC diff from git (rolebindings/*) 3) S3 object list + access logs for affected buckets 4) KMS key usage logs (CloudTrail) and key metadata.

Ashley: Tagging @DevSecOps Bot to kick an evidence export job. Also we should sanitize any PII from logs before handoff.

DevSecOps Bot: Evidence export job queued: job_id=EVID-20260101-11, owner=@Omar. Exports: k8s-audit, s3-access, cloudtrail-kms, rolebinding-diff. ETA ~ 45m.

Omar: Quick note — for KMS we need to include key aliases, key rotation history, and the CloudTrail entries that show Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls. I'll pull key metadata with:```aws kms list-keys --region us-east-1 && aws kms describe-key --key-id <key-id>```and CloudTrail query:```eventName = "Decrypt" OR eventName = "GenerateDataKey" | filter eventTime >= "2026-01-12T00:00:00Z" and eventTime <= "2026-01-13T12:00:00Z"```

Sara: For RBAC diff I'll produce a short narrative: who submitted change, PR link, review approvals, and the enacted kubectl apply timestamp. Example snippet:```diff --git a/rolebindings/prod/analytics.yaml b/rolebindings/prod/analytics.yaml index e69..b12
+  subjects:
+    - kind: ServiceAccount
+      name: analytics-runner
```

Ashley: We'll need a manifest mapping file (artifact -> explanation) for the auditor. Omar/Sara can you add a 1-paragraph rationale per artifact. I can handle console screenshots and the final packaging (zip + manifest).

Omar: Noted. Also flagging potential sensitive entries: a couple of audit lines contain user emails. I'll redact emails to <redacted_email> in the copies. Auditor OK with redaction?

Auditor_McKay: Redaction is fine, but please maintain original timestamps and principal IDs (hashed or redacted consistently). Include a short statement describing redaction method.

DevSecOps Bot: Evidence export job EVID-20260101-11 completed. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance-exports/EVID-20260101-11/. Checksums: sha256-summary.txt included.

Sara: Uploaded RBAC diff + narrative to the export bucket and linked PRs in the manifest. Paths: s3://redwood-compliance-exports/EVID-20260101-11/rolebinding-diff.txt and /manifest.md

Omar: CloudTrail KMS extracts and key metadata uploaded. I ran a quick sample query and included the exact command in manifest. Also included key rotation table: key-id, alias, first-ever-rotation, last-rotation.

Ashley: Packaging done. I'm sharing the export link with auditor via secure share (internal ticket). Sending now.

Auditor_McKay: Received the package, thanks. Quick follow-up: can you include evidence that the emergency access process was invoked (if it was) and the approval emails/Slack thread? Even redacted is fine.

Ashley: There was an emergency admin elevation for 2026-01-12 03:12 UTC. I added a sanitized export of the approval emails (redacted) and a paste of the Slack thread (redacted user IDs), path: /emergency-approvals.txt

Auditor_McKay: Perfect. One last ask: provide a small table mapping each control (SOC 2 CC6, ISO A.9) to the artifact filename and short explanatory note.

Sara: I'll add the control mapping appendix to manifest.md before EOD and ping when done.

Omar: Everything else on my side is complete. If you want me to sign the manifest (pgp) let me know.

Ashley: Please PGP-sign the manifest and include the public key fingerprint in the package. That will help provenance.

Omar: Done. Manifest signed, fingerprint: 3F2A 9B1C 6D5E 4A78 9C0D  B2E1 77AA 88BB CC12 3456 (uploaded).

Ashley: Awesome — thanks team. Closing this thread, moving the package to the auditor ticket with tracking. If they ask for raw logs we will provide on request with a secure link and retention window. :white_check_mark:
